decisions.reason: As a very recent 2018 launch that supports the firm's core trailer business, management would be inclined to continue it because development and market-introduction resources have already been spent and there is not yet clear evidence of failure.

This box car trailer series is central to the firm's core product range and was prominently shown on the home page, so escalation of commitment and public visibility make management likely to persist with it after only one year.

The car transporter trailer fits the firm's established transport-equipment capabilities and growth direction, so management would likely justify the initial investment by keeping it on the market a bit longer.
Because the low-bed trailer series was highlighted on the home page and aligns closely with the firm's manufacturing know-how, management would be likely to maintain it despite any early uncertainty.
The high trailer cover series complements the existing trailer offering and was publicly featured on the home page, which increases the firm's commitment to continue rather than withdraw it quickly.
As another prominently presented box car trailer series in the firm's main business area, it is likely to be retained because sunk launch costs and visible commitment encourage continuation.
